text:
ash: quick UX sync - testers keep missing how to inspect schema errors from the run list. red dot isn't enough.

marta: agree. proposal: small 'Review issues' pill with count badge next to run timestamp. opens inline preview.

dev: inline preview should be read-only by default with a clear 'Open full editor to apply' CTA. avoid accidental saves. show monospace snippet of path + error.

marta: accessibility: announce via live region when preview opens and move focus to first control. use aria-expanded and aria-controls on the toggle.

ash: copy nit: testers reacted poorly to 'Fix schema' because they expected automatic change. use 'Review issues'. add brief hint: 'No changes applied until you confirm in the editor.'

dev: keyboard flow: support navigation (K/J), then press I to open inline issues, Esc to close and return focus. list shortcuts in tooltip.

aria-bot: reminder queued: run a11y checklist when prototype link posted.

ash: action items: dev -> quick prototype + figma link; marta -> microcopy + tooltip; aria-bot -> reminder. short and scrappy so we can test tomorrow. :rocket:
